A '''safe house''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] was one of the few dozens safe houses set up and maintained across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He monitored all his safe houses as a matter of precaution, and security within was quite high. Around [[3640 BBY]] three assassins affiliated with Colonel [[Langor]] of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] attempted the wire the safe house with explosives. However, Lokin's security measures performed as designed and the house exploded, burning to the ground along with the bodes of the assassins.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eckard Lokin's Balmorra safe house is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Eckard Lokin's companion storyline.
